reasons.c.integration: The gRPC C arm runs the consumer and producer cases through the changed header FFI and fetch path.
reasons.c.unit: test_serialization.c gained a test, and the new FFI function kafka_common_header_Header__key_bytes changes the generated header and how header keys are returned, which every C client test uses.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: The .NET gRPC server runs the consumer and producer cases through the changed binding and core.
reasons.dotnet.performance: ConsumerBenchmark reads headers and builds against the changed consumer types.
reasons.dotnet.soak: The soak client builds against the changed ConsumerRecord and header types and reads headers in SoakRecord.
reasons.dotnet.solution: The .NET header and ConsumerRecord types, their interop marshalling and P/Invoke declarations changed, along with many unit and integration tests.
reasons.python.grpc: The gRPC Python arm runs the consumer and producer cases through the changed core.
reasons.python.integration: The broker tests consume and produce records with headers through the changed core.
reasons.python.performance: The consumer and transactional-producer perf tests use headers through the changed core.
reasons.python.static: test_ffi_twins compares the FFI surface, which gained kafka_common_header_Header__key_bytes.
reasons.python.unit: Python headers, consumer and producer go through the changed FFI header functions and RecordHeaders.
reasons.rust.chaos: Its workloads produce and consume records with headers through the changed fetch and producer paths.
reasons.rust.consumer: The consumer integration tests read ConsumerRecord headers, which now come from the encoded header section and are decoded on first access.
reasons.rust.integration: The fetch path every consumer goes through now keeps header slices and decodes keys that are not valid UTF-8 with replacement characters.
reasons.rust.integrity: It checks the records it consumes, and they come through the changed fetch and header path.
reasons.rust.lib: RecordHeader, RecordHeaders, DefaultRecord, Utils::utf8, completed_fetch, fetch_collector, producer_batch and the FFI header and consumer-record modules all changed, and each has unit tests.
reasons.rust.performance: Its producer and consumer perf tests use headers and the changed fetch path.
reasons.rust.producer: producer_batch changed how it writes record headers, which the producer integration tests exercise.
